title: Drop 3 Chords
summary: A deeper cousin of Drop 2: four-note chords with a silent string, how they compare, and how one note turns one chord into the next.

helpful.why: Drop 3 works the same way with a different note dropped.
Every chord here has four notes: a root, a third, a fifth and a seventh.
The lesson names each dot, and where it sits on its string.

card.title: Drop 3 Chords
card.subtitle: The third note drops, one string stays silent
